metadata.title: How to Write an AI Image Prompt | ShipFire
metadata.description: Build a clearer image prompt with a subject, setting, lighting and composition. See an example and learn how to refine one detail at a time.

answer.title: Build your prompt from clear ingredients

items.title: Subject and setting
items.description: Say what is in the image, where it is, and what the subject is doing.

items.title: Light, style and composition
items.description: Add the light source, visual style and placement of the subject. Avoid stacking contradictory instructions.

items.title: Review and refine
items.description: Compare the result with your intended scene, then change one important condition. Results vary, even when you reuse the same prompt.

examples.title: From a vague idea to a specific scene
examples.description: This compares prompt wording; it does not guarantee a particular generated result.

items.title: A product photo of a mug

input.label: Starting point
input.text: A nice photo of a mug.

output.label: More specific wording
output.text: A matte ceramic mug on a warm beige table, soft window light from the left, minimal composition, realistic product photography.

limits.title: What should you keep in mind?
paragraphs: A prompt helps communicate intent, but it cannot guarantee every detail. Check text, structure and factual content before publishing.
If a result misses the mark, simplify the prompt and add details gradually. Different models may interpret the same description differently.
